text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting authority to amend the existing parking regulations on the south side of Willowbank Boulevard, between Avenue Road and Castle Knock Road. The proposed parking amendments will address the concerns raised by local residents of street obstructions caused by vehicles stopped on the south side of this street. This report also identifies and rectifies conflicting parking by-laws on Willowbank Boulevard by introducing "house-keeping" by-law amendments.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Willowbank Boulevard, between Avenue Road and a point 15 metres west. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Willowbank Boulevard, between Castle Knock Road and a point 44 metres west of Avenue Road. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 9:15 a.m. to 11:15 a.m., 1:15 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. and 3:45 p.m. of one day to 8:45 a.m. of the next following day, Monday to Friday, and at all times, Saturday and Sunday, on the south side of Willowbank Boulevard, between a point 15 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 29 metres further west. 4.
